additional_info.body:
Hi Yunus,
We have checked the charger & logs.
We have observed that the power cycle resolved the issue.
Hence, it is not a issue now. Charger is healthy and available.
As for troubleshooting further,
Evaluate damage from visual inspection (if already done). If not done, support data collection from measurements and visual inspection.
For the inspection of the CCS Plug, Do not unmount the plug, else claims to Phoenix won't be possible.
Pls measure CP pin to ground. If Voltage is different from constant 12V DC, the cable must be replaced.
Report the findings on the ticket.
Looking forward to hear back from you.
Thank and Best Regards,

Giridhar "Gary"
